cat >> app/crud.py <<'EOF'


def get_item(*, session: Session, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> Item | None:
    return session.get(Item, item_id)


def clear_item_description(*, session: Session, db_item: Item) -> Item:
    db_item.description = None
    session.add(db_item)
    session.commit()
    session.refresh(db_item)
    return db_item
EOF
